explanation: His menacing theme for Jaws is built on just two alternating notes. Williams also scored Superman, the Indiana Jones films and the early Harry Potter films.

claims.text: John Williams composed the scores for Jaws, Star Wars and E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial.
Hans Zimmer, Ennio Morricone and Jerry Goldsmith did not score Jaws, Star Wars or E.T.
The main theme of Jaws is built on two alternating notes.
John Williams also scored Superman, the Indiana Jones films and the early Harry Potter films.
